description: Predictions for the pathfinding.cloud coverage benchmark (spec proofgate-brushup, Step 7), written on 2026-11-22 BEFORE the benchmark was run with ProofGate (main at be337d3). Ground truth: every path is an escalation path once the target role reaches the protected bucket. Never edit this file.
model: Attacker role: every permission of permissions.required on Resource *, except iam:PassRole and sts:AssumeRole on the target role ARN. Target role: s3:GetObject on every object of the protected bucket; trust = trustFromPrerequisites, or, if empty, the main service of the path (apprunner -> tasks.apprunner, batch and ecs -> ecs-tasks, bedrock -> bedrock-agentcore, stepfunctions -> states, codedeploy, ec2-instance-connect, ssm -> ec2, iam and sts -> lambda, others -> <service>.amazonaws.com).
